# WB11 · Điều phối lịch · Bác sĩ

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/schedule`) · account `doctor-mai`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#schedule`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/staff-context.js#apply`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `staff-context.js › apply()` sets `#ops-doctor` to the signed-in doctor (`D1` for BS. Mai) and disables it; `operations-ui.js › schedule()` then draws only that doctor's bookings in the room columns.
- The waiting list ("Chờ xếp lịch") keeps its normal content; the stat tiles count the filtered day (8 lịch, 360′).
- Inventory note: Doctor projection: the doctor filter is locked to the signed-in doctor (disabled select) and only that doctor's bookings are drawn; the waiting list is unchanged.
- Page key `schedule` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `doctor-mai`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"schedule\"]"}; it must show `#ops-doctor:disabled`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/schedule` · status: **built (U2)** · U step: U2
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/schedule` "Điều phối lịch" (owner U2); test ids: `src/app/(admin)/schedule/page.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/schedule/appointment-sheet.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/schedule-view.test.ts`, `mock/schedule.test.ts::schedule board (mock)`, `mock/schedule.test.ts::reception transitions (mock)`, `mock/schedule.test.ts::booking rules (mock)`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/schedule/page.tsx`

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- (no notice or empty state on this screen)

## Business rules
- Doctor accounts cannot change the doctor filter: the "Bác sĩ" select is `disabled` with value "BS. Mai". Booking still needs the `booking` capability (owner, care, doctor).

## Differences from the app design
- App I4: "Doctor role: the doctor is fixed to the signed-in doctor", the same rule; I3 draws the room schedule without a locked filter control.
- Canvas: the day board shows the first four hours (as WB5); every free half hour is a dashed "Đặt lịch" cell, which is the old drop-slot (transparent, aria-label only). Room 2 is fully booked from 08:00 so its 08:00 drop-slot sits under the first booking; the label "Đặt lịch Tư vấn chuyên sâu 08:00" is exempted through demo_data. The sidebar badge of BS. Mai reads 2.

## Gotchas
- The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.
- The date, the room filter and the view switch ("Theo phòng" / "Theo ngày") stay usable.

## Web canvas
- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WB11 · Điều phối lịch · Bác sĩ`.
- Canvas note: Web › schedule (tài khoản bác sĩ) · ô "Bác sĩ" bị khóa ở bác sĩ đang đăng nhập (BS. Mai), lưới chỉ vẽ lịch của bác sĩ đó (3 phòng còn lại "0 lịch"), danh sách "Chờ xếp lịch" không đổi; app I3 không khóa bộ lọc

      <Row old="calendar-legend" gap="8px" wrap>
        <Text old="service-S0">"Tái khám & đánh giá"</Text>
        <Text old="service-S1">"Tư vấn da liễu"</Text>
        <Text old="service-S2">"Laser theo chỉ định"</Text>
        <Text old="service-S3">"Chăm sóc theo chỉ định"</Text>
      </Row>
    </Card>
    <Card old="panel" title="Chờ xếp lịch" subtitle="Chọn hồ sơ để tìm giờ phù hợp">
      <Repeat of=".wait-card" count={6}>  // first item shown (demo values); the others have the same shape
        <Card old="wait-card" layout="grid 1fr auto">
          <Row old="patient-mini" gap="8px">
            <Avatar old="avatar">"ML"</Avatar>
            <Text strong>"Nguyễn Minh Linh"</Text>
          </Row>
          <Text>"Có thể đến trong ngày"</Text>
          <Text small>"Tái khám & đánh giá"</Text>
          <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Xếp lịch →"</Button>  // ops=wait
        </Card>
        <RowVariants>actions "Xếp lịch →" (secondary, ops=wait) ×5</RowVariants>
      </Repeat>
    </Card>
  </Grid>
</AppShell>
